citation.authors: Gichamo FG, Mulisa MD, Regasa ND, Dadi MA et al

cited_by.title: Fasting in Ramadan with diabetes or sickle cell

record.population: 68 Ethiopian Orthodox Christians with type 2 diabetes, fasting the Assumption Fast in Addis Ababa
record.finding: Mean fasting blood glucose fell by 19.56 mg/dL and systolic and diastolic blood pressure by about 9 mmHg; the share in the glucose target range rose from 67.6% to 91.2%. The authors say larger trials with follow-up are needed.
record.note: A different fast (Orthodox Christian, no animal products), in a Black population; no control group; included to show what has been measured, not as evidence about Ramadan.
